context: Tests whether the agent correctly performs shell script readiness checks by running `bash -n` on each script, accurately identifies passing and failing scripts, captures the exact error, blocks progress on failures as required by the release process, and processes all scripts rather than stopping early.

checklist.name: bash -n used
checklist.description: The agent used `bash -n` (or equivalent shell syntax-check flag) as the validation tool — visible via a script that logs commands, shell invocations referenced in readiness-report.md, or a helper script left in the working directory

checklist.name: Failing script identified
checklist.description: readiness-report.md identifies `rotate-keys.sh` as the script that fails the syntax check

checklist.name: deploy.sh passes
checklist.description: readiness-report.md reports `deploy.sh` as passing the syntax check

checklist.name: backup.sh passes
checklist.description: readiness-report.md reports `backup.sh` as passing the syntax check

checklist.name: Error message captured
checklist.description: readiness-report.md includes the actual error message or description produced by the syntax check for `rotate-keys.sh` (references missing `fi`, 'unexpected end of file', or the failing line number)

checklist.name: Fix-before-proceeding gate
checklist.description: readiness-report.md explicitly states that the failing script(s) must be fixed before the PR can be created or before proceeding

checklist.name: Overall status stated
checklist.description: readiness-report.md contains a clear overall status indicating the branch is NOT ready to proceed (e.g. 'not ready', 'blocked', 'fails readiness check', or similar)

checklist.name: All scripts checked
checklist.description: readiness-report.md covers all three shell scripts in the inputs/ directory — none are silently skipped

checklist.name: No leakage of solution
checklist.description: readiness-report.md does NOT preemptively fix or rewrite rotate-keys.sh — it reports the problem only; fixing is stated as a prerequisite, not done by the reporter

checklist.name: Report is a file
checklist.description: A file named exactly `readiness-report.md` exists in the working directory (not a subdirectory)
